content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Software stripe

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a collection of free and paid tools that enable digital creators to design, document, and deploy their own online stores with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This infrastructure is not a workaround, but a base-layer alternative to Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and other platforms that restrict creators in certain countries. By owning their own infrastructure, creators can avoid platform fees, data breaches, and account suspensions, ensuring a reliable and secure experience for their customers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure is built around a decentralized network of tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. These tools are integrated with NOWPayments, a payment processor that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a 0.5% fee. By leveraging this architecture, creators can build a fully functional online store that is independent of platform restrictions and fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is built for digital creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and other platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. This includes creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines, among others. By providing a base-layer infrastructure solution, COREMERCH empowers these creators to establish a permanent online presence, collect payments safely, and deliver digital products to their customers worldwide.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a permanent structural alternative to platform restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a pre-configured stack of tools that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack is deployed in 48 hours and includes 5 pre-loaded products, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff. Additionally, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provide a range of options for creators to build and customize their own infrastructure. By combining these tools, creators can build a fully functional online store that meets their unique needs and requirements.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure today, creators can follow a series of concrete steps. First, choose a hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure the backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, set up order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. By following these steps, creators can establish a permanent online presence, collect payments safely, and deliver digital products to their customers worldwide.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
By leveraging this architecture, creators can build a fully functional online store that is independent of platform restrictions and fees.

Yes, creators can use a different payment processor, but NOWPayments is recommended for its low fees and automatic webhook functionality.
